scripts.test: node --test "packages/engine/test/*.test.ts" "apps/server/test/*.test.ts" "apps/admin/test/*.test.ts" apps/client/test/storage.test.ts apps/client/test/battle-report.test.ts apps/client/test/battle-actions.test.ts apps/client/test/table-visuals.test.ts apps/client/test/local-art.test.ts apps/client/test/hover-timing.test.ts apps/client/test/card-sets.test.ts apps/client/test/painted-art.test.ts apps/client/test/battle-fx.test.ts apps/client/test/local-duel.test.ts apps/client/test/solo-settings.test.ts apps/client/test/touch-gesture.test.ts apps/client/test/session-recovery.test.ts apps/client/test/account-status.test.ts apps/client/test/account-request.test.ts apps/client/test/catalog-request.test.ts
scripts.test:render: vite build --config apps/client/vite.config.ts --ssr test/render-smoke.tsx --outDir ../../dist/render-test --emptyOutDir && node --test dist/render-test/render-smoke.js
scripts.preview:interface: vite build --config apps/client/vite.config.ts --ssr test/preview.tsx --outDir ../../dist/interface-preview --emptyOutDir && node dist/interface-preview/preview.js
scripts.test:preview: npm run preview:interface && npm run preview:animation && npm run build && node --test apps/client/test/offline-preview.test.ts
scripts.test:online-smoke: npm run build && node --test apps/client/test/online-smoke.test.ts apps/client/test/server-process.test.ts apps/client/test/online-acceptance.test.ts
scripts.web: npm run build && npm run server
